usedFor: DevRev holds work items, Slack is where your team sees them, and “Work Created” can post “Send Interactive Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Work Created” in DevRev, then “Send Interactive Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The message carries buttons or a form, so your team can approve or respond where the new work appears.

watchOut: An automation’s post to a Slack channel waits for your approval, so “Send Interactive Message” will not appear unprompted.
